scenario_description: A cleanly built wheel yields byte-specific inventory and license artifacts.
expected: Wheel metadata declares exactly the seven runtime dependencies in the manifest.
LICENSE, NOTICE, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES are physically present in the wheel.
SPDX, CycloneDX, checksums, and a readable license bundle are retained.
observed: The exact wheel SHA-256 is 836bcaadd07cf7a02103d8ee3f365fb674b90434df353db40599ad1f3f8135e4 with 29 members.
Seven runtime declarations matched the active distribution manifest and seven optional declarations stayed separate.
LICENSE, NOTICE, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md were embedded; the wheel CRC and generated SBOM/license artifacts were inspected.
A new isolated venv installed this wheel, pip check passed, the new review model imported, and the installed CLI accepted --license-review.
notes: PASS is artifact-specific technical evidence and not a general legal approval.
